# developerhub_current_user (Data Source)

The identity of the credentials this provider is configured with ("GET /api/1.0/user" - see DESIGN.md §5/§7). Its "name" is the developer_id used elsewhere in this provider, such as developerhub_application.developer_id, exactly as SAP's own documentation describes obtaining it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "developerhub_current_user" "me" {}

output "developer_id" {
  value = data.developerhub_current_user.me.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String)
- `first_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as "name" (present for Terraform Plugin Framework data source convention).
- `last_name` (String)
- `name` (String) The developer id ("Name" field in the API response).
